import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

# Simplify column names for readability
column_names = {
    'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived)': 'Authority',
    'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).1': 'Deprivation Rank',
    'Indices of Deprivation 2015 - South East U.A.s (n.b. Rank 1 = most deprived).9': 'Total Aggregate Deprivation'
}
df.rename(columns=column_names, inplace=True)

# Select top 5 most deprived authorities
top_5 = df.nsmallest(5, 'Deprivation Rank')

# Plot pie chart
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 8))
plt.pie(top_5['Total Aggregate Deprivation'], labels=top_5['Authority'], autopct='%1.1f%%')
plt.title('Proportion of Total Aggregate Deprivation Measure for Top 5 Most Deprived U.A.s')
plt.legend(top_5['Authority'], title="Authorities", loc="center left", bbox_to_anchor=(1, 0, 0.5, 1))
# Chart INFO: {'x_fields': '', 'y_fields': ['Total Aggregate Deprivation'], 'chart_type': 'pieChart'}
plt.show()
